questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: An isolated physical system transitions from initial state parameter $p_i = 18$ to final configuration $p_f = 22$ while conserving the quantity $\mathcal{E} = p_i^2 + 2p_f$. What is the value of $\mathcal{E}$ in SI units?

questions.question: When the amplitude of the driving excitation in a linear resistive medium (resistance $23$ units) is multiplied by $2$, by what factor does the rate of quadratic energy dissipation change?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A physical quantity $f(z)$ increases linearly from $0$ to $48$ units over the interval $z \in [0, 3]$. Evaluate $\int_0^{3} f(z)\,dz$.
questions.solution: Area of the right triangle under the linear curve is $\frac{1}{2} \times 3 \times 48 = 72$.
questions.explanation: Apply the graphical slope & area integration principles in Electromagnetic Waves (Displacement Current).
